<article title="Billing, charges, and invoices">
When you place an order we authorize the full amount, and the charge settles when the order ships. A pending authorization and a settled charge can both appear for a day or two, which looks like a double charge; the pending one drops off automatically within five business days.

Receipts are emailed when the order ships, and you can download an invoice for any order from the Orders page.

If a charge appears that does not match an order in your account, contact us with the amount and date and we will investigate. Real duplicate charges are refunded within five business days.

</article>

Customer first name: Ingrid
<request>
double charge on gift card order
i paid with a gift card and a credit card. the credit card was charged the full amount, and the gift card balance also went down. that is a double charge.
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Ingrid,

Thanks for reaching out. Our billing guidelines note that when you place an order, we authorize the full amount, and the charge settles when the order ships. A pending authorization and a settled charge can both appear for a day or two and may look like a double charge. Pending authorizations drop off automatically within five business days.

Your situation involves a gift card and a credit card, and the article doesn't cover how split payments are handled, so a specialist will follow up to review your order and both payment entries.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
